state_js: (() => { const s = new LocalStorageManager().getGameState(); return s ? {score: s.score, cells: s.grid.cells.map(col => col.map(t => t ? t.value : 0))} : null; })()
won_js: (() => { const s = new LocalStorageManager().getGameState(); return !!s && s.grid.cells.some(col => col.some(t => t && t.value >= 64)); })()
controls: Arrow keys slide all tiles. Equal tiles merge. R or the New Game button starts a fresh board.
goal: Make a tile worth at least 64.
notes: Run python -m tools.fetch_games first. Reads the game's saved board through LocalStorageManager without changing game files. The game clears this board on loss, so state is null after a loss. Random tiles and no replay frame counter: reports show Not reproducible and recordings use real time. The goal is a small milestone, not the full 2048 win. Browser proof within about 40 steps is owed.
